description: This Java class 'ChooseModuleStep' is part of the Android export signed package wizard, handling module selection within the Android project export process.

classes.name: ChooseModuleStep
classes.description: A wizard step class for selecting an Android module during the export process, extending ExportSignedPackageWizardStep.

methods.name: ChooseModuleStep
methods.description: Constructor initializing the module selection UI and logic based on provided facets.

methods.name: getSelectedFacet
methods.description: Returns the currently selected AndroidFacet from the combo box.

methods.name: getHelpId
methods.description: Provides the help ID string for context-sensitive help.

methods.name: commitForNext
methods.description: Validates the selection and sets the chosen facet in the wizard.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the main UI component for this wizard step.
